intro.text: Common spren that appear around angry people, as pools of boiling blood bubbling up around their feet.

description.text: When they arrive they make a loud screech, like sheets of steel grinding together.
They are nasty and dangerous even to other spren. The boiling blood seen in the Physical Realm is saliva drooling from their mouths.
Listeners see them as bolts of lightning spreading out from the angry person's feet.
